system.description:
INSIGHT UTILITY
Tradition arcane, divinity, ethereal
Cast 1 AP (somatic)
Range 60 feet
Targets 1 Studied Target you can perceive

You magically correlate countless small observations into one useful conclusion.
Choose one category:
Defences: Learn which of the target's Fortitude, Reflex or Will saves is lowest.
Resilience: Learn one significant Resistance, Weakness or Immunity possessed by the target.
Mobility: Learn its principal movement types and Speeds.
Senses: Learn its most significant unusual sense.
Capability: Learn one significant offensive, defensive or reactive ability not already known to you.
The GM provides one accurate fact within the chosen category.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Select one additional category.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. Choose a category: Defences, Resilience, Mobility and Senses are read off the target's sheet and whispered to you and the GM; Capability is the GM's.
